cursor.description: Continue the same document from its returned nextCursor.

maxBytes.description: Caller-selected byte budget for the serialized MCP response. Choose below the transport and output budgets; reduce it if transport reports an oversized response.

findingRef.description: Omit to page assigned findings and the previous aggregate without retained provenance bodies. Use source:<sourceFindingId> to fetch a complete original, or previous:<zero-based index> to fetch a complete previous aggregate finding, including its retained history.

complete.description: Omit or set true when submitting the finished aggregate.
